_help: Linux/macOS version — see archive-list.windows.json for Windows. Lists an archive's contents as text in Quick Look ("outputExt": "txt"), using libarchive's bsdtar (macOS's own tar is bsdtar; on Linux it's usually the libarchive-tools / bsdtar package). The grid keeps the plain file icon, since text output has no thumbnail. Preview generator config — see docs/generators.md for the full guide. Waydir ignores every key starting with "_" when loading.
_help_extensions: Lowercase extensions (no dot). A plain .gz that isn't a tarball has no member list, so it shows no preview.
_help_cmd: On macOS "tar" is bsdtar too; GNU tar (Linux's usual tar) only reads tar formats, not zip/7z/rar, so use bsdtar there.
_help_args: bsdtar -tvf prints an ls -l style listing to stdout ("stdout": true saves it as the output).
